The mixture of ice cream and yogurt gives a richer taste to this smoothie. Replacing the peaches with sliced bananas also works well.

==Ingredients==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (150 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] or 5.3 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) plain [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]] 
* ½ cup (125 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] or 4.2 oz) vanilla [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]]
* ½ cup (40 g or 1.4 oz) sliced [[Cookbook:Peach|peaches]]
* ½ cup (40 g or 1.4 oz) sliced [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]]

==Procedure==

#In a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]], blend the peaches, strawberries, yogurt, and ice cream until smooth.
